name: What are common mistakes to avoid when showing a luxury property?

mainEntity.name: What are common mistakes to avoid when showing a luxury property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common mistakes include over-personalizing the space, neglecting minor repairs, or not providing sufficient privacy during viewings. Another oversight is failing to properly communicate the unique lifestyle or high-end features that distinguish the property. Kelby Contreras advises against using unprofessional photography or allowing uncontrolled access, as these can detract from a luxury home's perceived value. A key avoidance is not highlighting area-specific advantages, such as proximity to beaches in Miami Beach or golfing in Palm Beach, which resonate with luxury buyers in these locations.
acceptedAnswer.description: Avoid over-personalization, neglecting repairs, or insufficient privacy. Also, ensure professional photography and highlight unique lifestyle benefits specific to your property's location.
